messages:
miriam: FYI BrightBank just escalated — p99 tail latency on Dedicated pool hitting SLA window during their nightly batch. They saw spikes around 22:10 UTC. Can we confirm owner and quick mitigation?

samir: on it. saw similar traces from pool-23 around that time, looks like KV cache misses and routing flapping between variants. attaching brief log: `Q: kv_miss_rate=12% | route_retries=4`

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-378 created for BrightBank latency (severity: P1). Pager duty notified.

cindy: quick question — is this the same routing rule change we rolled last week? PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4567 touched the policy.

dex: yep, that PR introduced a fallback selector that can trigger extra model cold starts if cache isn't primed. blame: `routing/selector.go` commit f213a.

ali: short-term mitigation idea: pin BrightBank to the previous routing profile for the next 2 hours and enable aggressive KV prewarm for their sessions. I can do the pin if owners approve.

miriam: we need two things: (1) explicit owner for the pin + deploy, (2) timeline for a proper fix (either revert or tune selector). Product needs a customer-facing ETA.

samir: I can own the quick pin + prewarm. Will open a small ops-change PR with the pin config. ETA 20–30m for PR + 10m for deploy if no objections.

product-liaison: BrightBank asked for a firm ETA. Can we commit to <=1 hour for a temporary fix and 48h for a root-cause patch? They'll escalate to legal if SLA keeps getting hit.

cindy: 48h for a proper patch seems feasible if we isolate the selector behavior. Need one perf test run to validate.

dex: agree. I'll pair with Samir on selector tuning — target: reduce retries and increase warm-up window. Plan: triage + small perf run (6h) + RC in staging then canary. So realistic ship: ~36–48h.

miriam: Samir + Dex = owners for engineering fix. Samir = owner for immediate pin/deploy. Cindy = review for the config PR. Ali = coordinate oncall and customer comms. Product-liaison will draft the customer message.

ali: pinging oncall to set escalation channel and to monitor after deploy. I'll post a bridge link in INC-2026-378.

incident-bot: Bridge created: https://meet.call/INC-2026-378 — attendees: samir, dex, ali, miriam.

samir: opening PR now: `ops/brightbank-pin-3532106789` — will request review from cindy.

cindy: looking now, will review within 15m. If green, assigning to infra-release for rapid deploy.

miriam: customer message draft (product-liaison pls): short-term: pinning routing to previous profile + prewarm, ETA ~40m. Longer-term: tuning selector + perf run, ETA 36–48h.

product-liaison: Draft ready, will send after we confirm deploy start time. Asking legal to standby if SLA letter needed.

samir: PR merged and queued for deploy (release pipeline: `hotfix/ops`). Kicking manual deploy now.

oncall-bot: Deploy started: hotfix/ops -> staging -> prod. CI: all checks passed.

ali: monitoring dashboards — opening p99 dashboard for pool-23, will post updates in incident.

miriam: thanks all. Next checkpoints: (A) confirm post-deploy latency within 40m (owner: Samir), (B) triage session in 2h to scope RCA (owners: Dex + Samir), (C) patch PR target in 48h (owner: Dex). Please update the incident thread with any blockers. :thumbsup:

samir: confirmed deploy finished, initial metrics look better — p99 down ~60% vs spike baseline. continuing to monitor.

ali: adding BrightBank CS rep to the incident thread and sending the short customer note now.

miriam: closing loop — thank you everyone for quick turnaround. We'll keep the incident open until RCA PR is merged.

product-liaison: customer acknowledged the short-term fix and asked for weekly updates until RCA closes. Noted.

samir: leaving a TODO in the PR: add perf test harness for selector scenarios.

cindy: will follow up on the review for the RCA patch when Dex opens it.

miriam: good. if anything changes ping here or escalate via INC-2026-378.
